audit_items.proof_trace: Both conditions are enforced in sequence: `assert!(whitelist.contains(&id), ...)` (line 162) checks whitelist membership, then `assert!((permission & (1u32 << what)) != 0, ...)` (lines 166-169) checks the specific permission bit.
